summary: AMETEK filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement for an unsecured senior notes offering, with size, coupon and maturity left blank. Proceeds, together with concurrent securities offerings, will repay borrowings under financing agreements and commercial paper used for the roughly $5 billion cash acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation, which closed August 26, 2026 under a May 5, 2026 purchase agreement. Notes carry a 101% change-of-control repurchase provision and optional redemption; BofA, J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, PNC and Truist are joint book-runners. This is routine debt financing, not a new special situation; watch pricing terms and leverage.
